goal: Mobile source citation UI in mobile/lib/features/urn_viewer/ and mobile/lib/features/explore/.
summary: Implemented authoritative mobile source citation UI and offline provenance preservation across mobile/lib/features/urn_viewer/ and mobile/lib/features/explore/. Developed domain entities in source_citation.dart (EpistemicCertainty, SourceRightsStatus, SourceCitation, HistoricalClaimCitation, EntityCitationBundle), accessible EpistemicBadge widget with color coding and screen reader semantics, and interactive draggable SourceCitationSheet presenting public locators (volume, chapter, page_start, page_end, section, folio), bibliographic citations (author, title, publisher, year, license, rights status), Hán-Nôm script glyphs with Sino-Vietnamese reading, and bilingual translations. Enforced strict avoidance of unauthorized restricted snippets by redacting copyrighted/unlicensed text to '[REDACTED: RIGHTS_RESTRICTED]' for public users while preserving citation metadata. Integrated SourceCitationSheet into MotifSidebar, UrnViewerScreen, and Explore UrnCard. Extended HiveStorage with a dedicated citationsBox. Built entity_citations.py backend service with SHA-256 provenance hash chaining and added GET /api/v1/history/citations/{slug_or_id} and GET /api/v1/history/entities/{slug_or_id}/citations endpoints. Verified strict negative abuse guardrails ensuring offline content preserves original citation provenance and rejects stripped sources, promoted disputed claims, or forged provenance hashes.
invariants_enforced: PUBLIC_LOCATORS_DISPLAY: Public locators (volume, chapter, page_start, page_end, section, folio, inscription location) formatted with scholarly precision and displayed across mobile citation sheets.
BIBLIOGRAPHIC_CITATIONS_LINKAGE: Authoritative primary source metadata (title, author, publisher, publication_year, license, rights_status, archive_url) bound to claims and relics.
BILINGUAL_AND_HAN_NOM_TRANSLATIONS: Hán-Nôm script characters, Sino-Vietnamese reading (phiên âm), and modern Vietnamese/English translations rendered prominently with elegant typography.

EPISTEMIC_UNCERTAINTY_INDICATORS: Dynamic epistemic badges (documented / Sử liệu xác thực, traditional / Truyền thuyết dân gian, uncertain / Đang khảo cứu, disputed / Có tranh luận) prevent unverified or folkloric claims from claiming settled factual authority.

AVOID_UNAUTHORIZED_RESTRICTED_SNIPPETS: Rights-restricted and unlicensed excerpts are strictly redacted to '[REDACTED: RIGHTS_RESTRICTED]' for public/anonymous users, preventing copyright infringement while preserving citation metadata. Privileged staff users retain access for academic audit.

NEGATIVE_ABUSE_OFFLINE_PROVENANCE_PRESERVATION: Offline content preserves original citation provenance; cannot strip source attribution. Attempting to mark claims verified while dropping sources, stripping locators, promoting disputed claims, or tampering with SHA-256 provenance hashes is strictly rejected with typed exceptions.
MOBILE_INTERACTIVE_CITATION_SHEET: Draggable modal bottom sheet (SourceCitationSheet) wired into MotifSidebar, UrnViewerScreen, and UrnCard with complete loading, error, empty, and loaded states.
HIVE_AUTHENTICATED_OFFLINE_CACHE: HiveStorage citationsBox caches and retrieves verified bundles with provenance integrity checks on read and write.

verification.git_diff_check: PASSED (0 trailing whitespace or EOF errors)

test_cases.name: test_public_locator_formatting
test_cases.assertion: Verifies scholarly public locator string assembly across various archival units (volume, chapter, folio, pages, inscription location).

test_cases.name: test_epistemic_uncertainty_classifier
test_cases.assertion: Verifies dynamic epistemic certainty assignment for documented, traditional, uncertain, and disputed assertions.

test_cases.name: test_unauthorized_restricted_snippets_avoidance
test_cases.assertion: Verifies that copyrighted/restricted excerpts are strictly redacted to [REDACTED: RIGHTS_RESTRICTED] for public queries while preserving bibliographic metadata, and accessible to privileged staff.

test_cases.name: test_open_public_domain_excerpt_permitted
test_cases.assertion: Verifies that public domain and CC0 sources allow unredacted excerpt display.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_offline_content_stripping_sources_rejected
test_cases.assertion: Verifies that offline cache bundles attempting to mark claims as verified while stripping source attribution are strictly rejected with MissingSourceAttributionError.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_disputed_claim_cannot_be_promoted_in_offline_bundle
test_cases.assertion: Verifies that disputed claims cannot be forged as verified in offline cache, failing with DisputedClaimPromotionError.

test_cases.name: test_negative_abuse_tampered_provenance_hash_rejected
test_cases.assertion: Verifies that altering statement text or sources without a valid SHA-256 provenance signature fails with CitationProvenanceError.

test_cases.name: test_mobile_source_citation_architectural_analysis
test_cases.assertion: Audits Flutter mobile client code verifying source_citation.dart, source_citation_sheet.dart, epistemic_badge.dart, motif_sidebar.dart, urn_card.dart, and hive_storage.dart.

test_cases.name: test_api_citation_endpoint_e2e
test_cases.assertion: Verifies GET /api/v1/history/citations/{slug_or_id} returns full structured citations with real database rows.

changes.description: Created domain entities for mobile source citations: EpistemicCertainty, SourceRightsStatus, SourceCitation, HistoricalClaimCitation, EntityCitationBundle, CitationProvenanceError, and MissingSourceAttributionError with provenance integrity verification.
Created accessible EpistemicBadge widget supporting documented, traditional, uncertain, and disputed states with screen reader semantics and color-coded indicators.

Implemented DraggableScrollableSheet displaying verified bibliographic citations, public locators, Hán-Nôm script glyphs, Sino-Vietnamese readings, translations, and secure [REDACTED: RIGHTS_RESTRICTED] snippet handling.
Created entityCitationsProvider loading remote API citations and falling back to authenticated Hive cache with strict offline provenance integrity checks.
Wired 'Tra cứu nguồn sử liệu gốc' button opening SourceCitationSheet for selected motif/relief.
Wired 'Tra cứu nguồn thư tịch & sử liệu gốc' button into Urn info bottom sheet opening SourceCitationSheet.
Added 'Nguồn sử liệu' action button on Urn cards opening SourceCitationSheet for the urn.
Added citationsBox support with cacheEntityCitations and getCachedEntityCitations methods.

Implemented backend citation resolution service supporting public locator formatting, epistemic uncertainty classification, excerpt redaction for restricted sources, SHA-256 provenance hash generation, and offline provenance validation.
Added SourceCitationOut, HistoricalClaimCitationOut, and EntityCitationBundleOut Pydantic schemas.

Created comprehensive 9-test suite validating public locators, bibliographic citations, translations, epistemic indicators, unauthorized restricted snippets avoidance, negative abuse offline provenance preservation, architectural audit, and E2E API integration.
